meta.title: Revision history on the buyer side
gaps: Step through Vendor A's revisions with the buyer-side arrows and verify the trail shows Current Bid 3, 2 Revision, and 1 Revision with each price and timestamp, then verify Reset returns to the current bid.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Step through Vendor A's revisions with the buyer-side arrows and verify the trail shows Current Bid 3, 2 Revision, and 1 Revision with each price and timestamp, then verify Reset returns to the current bid.

steps.note: Create the event used for the vendor revision journey.
Use an RFQ pricing stage for the vendor bid.
Apply the pricing template before adding line items.
Add the line item required for bidding.
Complete the pricing sheet so the event can be published.
Invite the QA vendor who will submit the revisions.
Confirm the event reached a published project page.
Verify the initial bid was accepted.
Submit Vendor A's first revision, decreasing the bid to 95.
Verify the first revision was accepted.
Submit Vendor A's second revision, decreasing the bid to 90.
Verify the second revision was accepted.
Navigate to the buyer-side Responses view where revision history should be inspected.

args.need: on the buyer-side Responses view, use Vendor A's revision arrows to inspect Current Bid 3, 2 Revision, and 1 Revision with their prices and timestamps, then press Reset and verify it returns to the current bid

steps.note: The catalog has no step for operating or asserting the revision-history arrows and Reset behavior.
Assert that the buyer-side revision-history trail is visible after the manual inspection.
